resourceProfile.assessment: The complete English and Simplified Chinese source scope, review metadata, glossary, and project concept references were available locally.

automatedQuality.summary: Translation review metadata, queue validation, typecheck, 79 test files with 462 tests, complete build, 39 IIS rules with 61 route cases, and 724 generated-link checks passed.

linguisticCritique.summary: A bounded Simplified Chinese pass identified 25 actionable unit-formatting, false-friend, grammar, electrical, circuit, thermal, and formula defects; all 25 were corrected.

competentHumanReview.summary: No competent Simplified Chinese human review was performed in this cycle; changed IDs remain machine-drafted.

publicationAuthorization.summary: No merge, publication, deployment, or residual-risk authorization was requested or granted.

findings.summary: The rearranged-formulas heading was a literal translation rather than standard technical Chinese.
evidence: The previous title was 重新排列的公式.
findings.resolution: Changed it to 变形公式.

findings.summary: The worked-examples heading used 工作实例, which is less natural for a calculator example section.
evidence: The previous title was 工作实例.
findings.resolution: Changed it to 示例.

findings.summary: The example setup omitted spaces between numeric values and units.
evidence: The previous text was 4.2 V 电源连接到 1.0Ω 负载.
findings.resolution: Added standard spacing around 1.0 Ω.

findings.summary: The conclusion omitted spacing before the current unit.
evidence: The previous text was 负载电流为4.2A.
findings.resolution: Changed it to 负载电流为 4.2 A.

findings.summary: The example setup omitted spaces between current and resistance values and their units.
evidence: The previous text was 0.5A电流流过10Ω电阻.
findings.resolution: Changed it to 0.5 A 电流流过 10 Ω 电阻.

findings.summary: The power paragraph mistranslated safety headroom as heat capacity and clearance.
evidence: The previous text used 足够的热容量和净空来散发热量.
findings.resolution: Rewrote it with sufficient heat-dissipation capability and an appropriate safety margin.

findings.summary: The summary said current turned resistance into heat instead of electrical energy.
evidence: The previous summary was 电流如何将电阻转化为热量.
findings.resolution: Changed it to electrical energy being converted to heat by current.

findings.summary: The heating-power heading was less precise than the standard term for generated heat.
evidence: The previous title was 加热功率.
findings.resolution: Changed it to 发热功率.

findings.summary: The worked-example heading used a literal work-related term.
evidence: The previous title was 工作示例.
findings.resolution: Changed it to 示例.

findings.summary: The setup used 承载 for current through a coil, which can imply a load rating rather than current flow.
evidence: The previous setup was 0.8Ω 线圈可承载 3A 电流.
findings.resolution: Rewrote it as 3 A current passing through a 0.8 Ω coil.

findings.summary: The heading was an awkward literal question using 供暖, which suggests building heating.
evidence: The previous title was 影响供暖的因素有哪些.
findings.resolution: Changed it to 影响发热的因素.

findings.summary: The heat-transfer bullet translated hardware as 硬件.
evidence: The previous text referred to heat transfer to 空气、液体和硬件.
findings.resolution: Changed it to the technical term 设备.

findings.summary: The paragraph needed clearer distinction between power, temperature, heat capacity, and heat-flux density.
evidence: The previous text used 热通量 without clarifying the areal quantity and used an awkward surface-exit phrase.
findings.resolution: Rewrote it with clear technical distinctions and natural Chinese.

findings.summary: The safety paragraph used 余量 without clearly identifying it as a safety margin.
evidence: The previous text said 使用适当的余量.
findings.resolution: Rewrote it with 适当的安全裕量 and clearer equipment checks.

findings.summary: The circuit-terms introduction was a literal phrase that did not naturally describe circuit analysis.
evidence: The previous text was 基本术语使电路图更容易推理.
findings.resolution: Changed it to a natural introduction to analyzing circuit diagrams.

findings.summary: The current-law example rendered 8 A as 8 个 A and used awkward current-direction wording.
evidence: The previous text began 如果 8 个 A 进入一个节点 and ended with 选择当前方向.
findings.resolution: Rewrote it with correct units, flow wording, and assumed-direction explanation.

findings.summary: The series-resistor setup omitted spaces between values and units and used redundant connection wording.
evidence: The previous text was 两个0.20Ω电阻串联连接到8.0V.
findings.resolution: Changed it to two 0.20 Ω resistors connected in series to an 8.0 V source.

findings.summary: The cell heading was less direct than standard Chinese battery terminology.
evidence: The previous title was 串联和并联的电池.
findings.resolution: Changed it to 电池串联和并联.

findings.summary: The series-cell bullet needed clearer battery-capacity wording.
evidence: The previous text said 安时容量仍保持为同等电池的水平.
findings.resolution: Rewrote it to state that voltage adds while ampere-hour capacity matches one equivalent cell.

findings.summary: The parallel-cell bullet used a vague phrase for approximate addition.
evidence: The previous text said 容量和可用电流大约增加.
findings.resolution: Rewrote it to state that capacity and available current approximately add.

findings.summary: The charging warning used 电池级监控 rather than the clearer individual-cell term.
evidence: The previous text was 串联锂离子充电需要电池级监控.
findings.resolution: Changed it to 单体级 monitoring with balancing or protection.

findings.summary: The limits paragraph needed more natural high-current terminology and a concise instruction.
evidence: The previous text ended with 对高电流电路产生重大影响的所有被遗漏的行为.
findings.resolution: Rewrote it with 大电流电路 and clear omitted-factor wording.

findings.summary: The TCR variable definition omitted spaces around the equation symbols.
evidence: The previous text was R_0是参考温度T_0下的电阻.
findings.resolution: Changed it to standard Chinese equation spacing.

findings.summary: The current formula contained the Chinese pronoun 我 instead of the variable I.
evidence: The previous formula was 我=V/R.
findings.resolution: Changed it to I = V / R.

findings.summary: The triangle explanation contained repeated and incorrect literal descriptions of sides and functions.
evidence: The previous paragraph repeated 对边 and described sine, cosine, and tangent relationships inaccurately.
findings.resolution: Rewrote it with correct opposite, adjacent, hypotenuse, and SOH-CAH-TOA definitions.
